## Bug Analysis

**Bug:** When GNSS is stopped, the filter text ("Showing X of Y satellites") remains visible on screen.

**File:** `GPSTest/src/main/java/com/android/gpstest/GpsStatusFragment.java`

In the `setStarted(false)` block (lines 310-312), added two lines after clearing satellite adapters:

```java
// Clear GNSS filter when GNSS is stopped
PreferenceUtils.saveGnssFilter(new LinkedHashSet<>());
updateFilterView();
```

- **`updateFilterView()`** — Updates the filter UI; since the filter is now empty, it sets `filterGroup.setVisibility(View.GONE)`, hiding the filter text and group

Both methods are already imported and used elsewhere in the same class, ensuring correctness.
